verdicts.reason: A is a shrunken centred copy, not a banner layout. The SOLSTICE logo is an illegible speck at far left, and the CTA is tiny and wraps to leave the orphan word 'Line' on its own line, so there is no usable call to action. B reads left to right with a readable headline and the CTA on the right, but the brand is effectively gone: only a faint dot is left where the sun icon was and the SOLSTICE wordmark is missing. Its CTA is cramped against the right edge and wraps to two lines, and the headline crowds the left edge.
